description: DOE’s H2A production models apply a consistent discounted-cash-flow methodology to hydrogen production at central and distributed facilities. They expose process-design, capital, operating, fuel and finance assumptions. The provider is US DOE H2A team and National Laboratory of the Rockies. Coverage: Coverage is generic to user-selected production pathways. Default case studies do not establish universal costs or a fixed geographic or calendar scope. Access: DOE links the production models and case studies through the laboratory website. Model files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Defaults are technology- and scenario-specific. Licence, current model versions and numerical results were not audited. For simulation it supports production-cost comparisons under explicit financial and engineering assumptions. Related resources: HDSAM and pyH2A are separately prepared in this batch. They are delivery and derivative analysis tools, not a covering existing record.
